rationale: KYMR has gapped up ~6.7% on massive relative volume (7.16x) and is now trading at 96.5% of its intraday range near the session high, suggesting the initial momentum burst is largely exhausted. The bid-ask spread of 77.5 bps on a $173 stock creates significant friction, and with price already extended well above the 9-EMA ($159.51) and VWAP ($167.74), chasing long here carries poor risk/reward while a short against a strong catalyst-driven move with no clear resistance overhead is equally unattractive. The risk of a sharp mean-reversion or continuation without a clean setup level makes skipping the prudent choice.
